summary: Backend tests for the guest query path: guest_queries row written, zero authenticated-side writes
description: Depends on the guest query path. Integration tests: (a) first guest query returns a full streamed answer with citations AND writes exactly one guest_queries row with cost_usd + tokens + ip_name populated; (b) second query on same guest token refused (one-shot); (c) guest:<ip> throttle rejects after N across rotated tokens; (d) assert NO users/sessions/queries row and NO user_budgets reservation created for a guest call; (e) signed-cookie tamper rejected. Mirror existing style in src/__tests__.
